inductive_transitions_matrix.transition_pair: #1 Boeing 747-8 BBJ (VIP  -> #2 Airbus A380 Flying Pal
inductive_transitions_matrix.inductive_reasoning: Expands on Car/Jet #1's multi-deck space: 6,000 sq ft across two full-length decks, private Turkish hammam steam room, marble-lined master suites, and grand spiral staircase.
inductive_transitions_matrix.patron_need: The largest private flying residence ever conceived; hosting an entire royal court and medical suite.
inductive_transitions_matrix.trade_off_passed: Extremely limited airport gate compatibility (requires Code F / A380-capable taxiways) and $31,000/hr direct operating cost.

inductive_transitions_matrix.transition_pair: #2 Airbus A380 Flying Pal -> #3 Boeing 777-9 BBJ (BBJ
inductive_transitions_matrix.inductive_reasoning: Addresses the four-engine inefficiency and Code F restrictions of Jet #1 and #2: twin-engine GE9X architecture with folding carbon-fiber wingtips allowing Code E gate compatibility, flying 11,000 nautical miles non-stop (Sydney to London non-stop).
inductive_transitions_matrix.patron_need: Point-to-point connection between any two cities on planet Earth without technical fuel stops.
inductive_transitions_matrix.trade_off_passed: Massive widebody scale still prevents operation into regional airfields.

inductive_transitions_matrix.inductive_reasoning: Advances Jet #3's environmental health: 53% carbon-fiber composite airframe allows a 5,500 ft cabin altitude and 20% higher cabin humidity, eliminating jet lag on 20-hour missions.
inductive_transitions_matrix.patron_need: Wellness-first sovereign transport; arriving in Tokyo or New York completely rested and refreshed.
inductive_transitions_matrix.trade_off_passed: 3,300 sq ft cabin requires specialized VIP completion centers with 24-month build timelines.

inductive_transitions_matrix.inductive_reasoning: Refines widebody proportions into the sweet spot of global VIP charter: oversized electrochromic dimmable windows, 6,000 ft cabin altitude, and lower DOC than the 777X.
inductive_transitions_matrix.patron_need: Ultra-HNW family and executive leadership transport combining spaciousness with high charter demand liquidity.
inductive_transitions_matrix.trade_off_passed: Cannot access regional runways under 7,500 ft.

inductive_transitions_matrix.inductive_reasoning: Leverages Airbus 'Harmony' cabin design philosophy: holographic globes, modular VIP zones, and Rolls-Royce Trent 7000 engines with 25% lower fuel burn than prior-gen A330s.
inductive_transitions_matrix.patron_need: Turn-key corporate widebody charter with seamless global support network.
inductive_transitions_matrix.trade_off_passed: Slightly lower cruise speed (Mach 0.82) compared to Mach 0.85+ on the 787 and A350.

inductive_transitions_matrix.inductive_reasoning: Addresses the immense acquisition price barrier of brand-new widebodies ($300M+): retrofitting an ultra-reliable 767 airframe into a cultural masterpiece with velvet gold-leaf lounges and leather master suites at a fraction of the capital cost.
inductive_transitions_matrix.patron_need: A-list music titans and sports moguls requiring world-tour entourage accommodation with peerless swagger.
inductive_transitions_matrix.trade_off_passed: Older avionics and legacy engines yield higher fuel burn per hour than composite twins.

inductive_transitions_matrix.inductive_reasoning: Cures Jet #7's fuel burn penalty: modern CFM LEAP-1A high-efficiency single-aisle fuselage, delivering true non-stop trans-Atlantic range (London to New York) with a full master bedroom and walk-in shower at under $8,500/hr DOC.
inductive_transitions_matrix.patron_need: The perfect balance of airliner cabin cross-section with corporate jet operating costs.
inductive_transitions_matrix.trade_off_passed: Single-aisle width (12'1") lacks the twin-aisle palatial feeling of the 787 or A350.

inductive_transitions_matrix.transition_pair: #8 Airbus A321LR / A321ne -> #9 Boeing 737 MAX 9 BBJ (
inductive_transitions_matrix.inductive_reasoning: Adds over 1,150 nautical miles over Jet #8: auxiliary fuel tanks allow 6,555 nmi non-stop range, easily linking Los Angeles to London or Tokyo with a customized Sky Retreat interior.
inductive_transitions_matrix.patron_need: Global business travel without airliner mass, backed by Boeing's ubiquitous worldwide spares network.
inductive_transitions_matrix.trade_off_passed: Cabin width is 11'7", slightly narrower than the Airbus ACJ320neo family.

inductive_transitions_matrix.transition_pair: #9 Boeing 737 MAX 9 BBJ ( -> #10 Airbus A220 ACJ (ACJ T
inductive_transitions_matrix.inductive_reasoning: Disrupts the airliner-VIP segment by dropping runway requirements to 5,300 ft and DOC to $5,900/hr, while providing three times the cabin volume of traditional long-range bizjets with 6 separate living zones.
inductive_transitions_matrix.patron_need: The space of a bizliner for the purchase price and operating cost of an ultra-long-range business jet.
inductive_transitions_matrix.trade_off_passed: Cruise Mach is capped at 0.82, slower than pure-purpose business jets (Mach 0.90+).

inductive_transitions_matrix.transition_pair: #10 Airbus A220 ACJ (ACJ T -> #11 Boeing 737-7 BBJ (BBJ
inductive_transitions_matrix.inductive_reasoning: The battle-tested patriarch of the BBJ family: exceptional resale liquidity, bulletproof CFM56 engines serviceable at literally any commercial airport on earth, and 6,200 nmi range.
inductive_transitions_matrix.patron_need: Zero-risk fleet reliability; guaranteed parts availability in remote continents.
inductive_transitions_matrix.trade_off_passed: Previous-generation CFM56 engines lack the fuel burn gains of LEAP or GTF powerplants.

inductive_transitions_matrix.inductive_reasoning: Closes Tier I with extreme 6,750 nmi range (15 hours non-stop) in a boutique wide single-aisle footprint: flying 8 VIP passengers non-stop from London to Beijing or Perth to Dubai in total comfort.
inductive_transitions_matrix.patron_need: Uncompromising trans-polar non-stop VIP endurance with a 7-foot ceiling.
inductive_transitions_matrix.trade_off_passed: Transitions the fleet from airliner airframes to purpose-built clean-sheet business jets.

inductive_transitions_matrix.inductive_reasoning: Breaks through airliner speed barriers: supersonic test-proven at Mach 1.015, regular cruise at Mach 0.94. Features an industry-record 2,900 ft cabin altitude at FL410, Smooth FlxFlt wing, Nuage zero-gravity seats, and 8,000 nmi non-stop range.
inductive_transitions_matrix.patron_need: The fastest, longest-range, technologically superior purpose-built business aircraft in human history.
inductive_transitions_matrix.trade_off_passed: Large 111-foot wingspan requires heavy hangar footprint; lacks steep-approach trijet agility.

inductive_transitions_matrix.inductive_reasoning: Matches Jet #13's range while providing the lowest cabin altitude in business aviation (2,840 ft at FL410) and 20 iconic panoramic oval windows flooding the cabin with natural sunlight.
inductive_transitions_matrix.patron_need: The premier American boardroom in the sky; peerless global prestige and Gulfstream resale value retention.
inductive_transitions_matrix.trade_off_passed: Firm wing structure gives slightly more turbulence sensitivity than the Global's flexible wing.

inductive_transitions_matrix.inductive_reasoning: Answers Gulfstream and Bombardier with the widest and tallest cabin in purpose-built business aviation (6'8" height, 9'1" width), carbon-fiber high-aspect wing, and fighter-jet derived Digital Flight Control System with single-lever Smart Throttle.
inductive_transitions_matrix.patron_need: Residential luxury rivaling widebody airliners with Dassault Rafale fighter-jet fly-by-wire safety.
inductive_transitions_matrix.trade_off_passed: Entry into service timeline scheduled behind G700 and Global 7500.

inductive_transitions_matrix.inductive_reasoning: The proven king of the secondary market: over 500 aircraft flying, 125+ world speed records, legendary residual value retention, and immediate delivery availability.
inductive_transitions_matrix.patron_need: Proven blue-chip reliability; instant global liquidity and established pilot pool.
inductive_transitions_matrix.trade_off_passed: Lacks the 4-zone master bedroom with shower of the newer G700 and Global 7500.

inductive_transitions_matrix.inductive_reasoning: Addresses the G650ER's lack of permanent master bedroom: 4 full living zones including a dedicated master suite with permanent bed, en-suite shower, and a full-size kitchen.
inductive_transitions_matrix.patron_need: True residential living at 51,000 feet; conducting multi-leg world tours without hotel dependence.
inductive_transitions_matrix.trade_off_passed: Heavy ramp weight approaches corporate jet limits at sensitive airports.

inductive_transitions_matrix.inductive_reasoning: Directly solves the runway restriction of twin-engine heavy jets: three-engine redundancy and slow approach speeds allow operations into London City Airport (5.5° glideslope), Aspen, and Lugano, combined with 6,450 nmi range.
inductive_transitions_matrix.patron_need: Non-stop trans-oceanic capability operating out of restricted city-center and mountain airports.
inductive_transitions_matrix.trade_off_passed: Three engines require three overhaul cycles; cabin width is 7'8", narrower than the Falcon 10X or G700.

inductive_transitions_matrix.inductive_reasoning: Replaces trijet maintenance with clean-sheet twin PW815GA engines, Symmetry Flight Deck with active control sidesticks, and Mach 0.90 high-speed cruise covering 6,600 nmi.
inductive_transitions_matrix.patron_need: Corporate executives needing New York to Paris or London to Singapore at high speed with low DOC.
inductive_transitions_matrix.trade_off_passed: Cabin is divided into 3 zones rather than 4.

inductive_transitions_matrix.inductive_reasoning: Addresses Jet #19's cabin cross-section: introduces the tallest cabin in business aviation (6'6" standing height, 8'6" width), featuring a unique overhead skylight flooding the galley with daylight.
inductive_transitions_matrix.patron_need: Unmatched headroom and cross-sectional volume in a twinjet capable of London to Los Angeles non-stop.
inductive_transitions_matrix.trade_off_passed: 5,500 nmi range falls short of true trans-Pacific routes (San Francisco to Tokyo).

inductive_transitions_matrix.inductive_reasoning: Adds 1,100 nmi over the Falcon 6X: 6,600 nmi range with Rolls-Royce Pearl 15 engines, Nuage chaise lounge, and Pur Air hospital-grade HEPA filtration system.
inductive_transitions_matrix.patron_need: Reliable 14-hour non-stop flights with low cabin noise and clean health environment.
inductive_transitions_matrix.trade_off_passed: Legacy fuselage shape is narrower than the clean-sheet Falcon 6X.

inductive_transitions_matrix.inductive_reasoning: Drops capital cost under $50M while preserving Mach 0.90 cruise speed, Symmetry active control sidesticks, and trans-Atlantic capability.
inductive_transitions_matrix.patron_need: High-speed American coast-to-coast and Europe missions with low fuel burn.
inductive_transitions_matrix.trade_off_passed: 3-zone layout is slightly shorter than the G600.

inductive_transitions_matrix.inductive_reasoning: Adds 600 nmi over the G500: flies 5,900 nmi from short runways like Aspen, Colorado or St. Moritz, connecting remote ski chalets directly to Europe.
inductive_transitions_matrix.patron_need: Mountain airfield performance combined with trans-oceanic endurance.
inductive_transitions_matrix.trade_off_passed: Cruises at Mach 0.85, slightly slower than the G500's Mach 0.90.

inductive_transitions_matrix.inductive_reasoning: The ultimate trijet mountain performer: can land on runways as short as 4,000 ft, refuel, and fly 4,750 nmi across oceans without weight-shedding penalties.
inductive_transitions_matrix.patron_need: Unmatched mountain airstrip safety and oceanic peace of mind with three engines.
inductive_transitions_matrix.trade_off_passed: Honeywell TFE731 engines are an older architecture than modern Rolls-Royce or Pratt twins.

inductive_transitions_matrix.inductive_reasoning: The biggest value breakthrough in business aviation: cuts acquisition cost in HALF ($22.5M) while providing full fly-by-wire with active turbulence reduction and non-stop London to New York range (4,018 nmi) with 4 passengers.
inductive_transitions_matrix.patron_need: Trans-Atlantic non-stop private ownership with the DOC of a midsize aircraft ($2,850/hr).
inductive_transitions_matrix.trade_off_passed: Two-zone cabin; lacks dedicated aft private stateroom.

inductive_transitions_matrix.inductive_reasoning: Addresses Jet #25's interior ergonomics: introduces the Nuage zero-gravity seat into the super-midsize segment, voice-controlled cabin management, wireless phone charging, and lowest cabin altitude in class (4,850 ft).
inductive_transitions_matrix.patron_need: Coast-to-coast non-stop executive travel with the world's most proven charter resale value.
inductive_transitions_matrix.trade_off_passed: Range is 3,400 nmi; cannot complete eastbound trans-Atlantic flights into headwinds without fuel stop.

inductive_transitions_matrix.inductive_reasoning: Matches the Challenger with an ultra-quiet cabin (lowest interior noise level in super-midsize), Garmin G5000 avionics with autothrottles, and true non-stop New York to London capability.
inductive_transitions_matrix.patron_need: Quiet, stress-free transcontinental flights backed by Textron's massive worldwide service center network.
inductive_transitions_matrix.trade_off_passed: Cabin width is 6'5", slightly narrower than the Challenger 3500.

inductive_transitions_matrix.inductive_reasoning: Brings Gulfstream Symmetry Flight Deck, active control sidesticks, and 10 large oval windows down into the 4,200 nmi segment, flying New York to Geneva non-stop.
inductive_transitions_matrix.patron_need: Gulfstream brand pedigree and flight deck technology in a 2.5-living-area footprint.
inductive_transitions_matrix.trade_off_passed: Higher acquisition cost than Embraer Praetor 600.

inductive_transitions_matrix.inductive_reasoning: Offers the widest cabin in its class (8'2" width) at a lower cost than long-range flagships, backed by over 1,000 aircraft delivered across the Challenger 600 family.
inductive_transitions_matrix.patron_need: Spacious widebody executive meetings and multi-passenger corporate transport.
inductive_transitions_matrix.trade_off_passed: Cruise ceiling of FL410 means it cannot always climb above severe weather like FL510 jets.

inductive_transitions_matrix.inductive_reasoning: Brings full fly-by-wire into the midsize class: short 4,222 ft runway access, true coast-to-coast non-stop range (3,340 nmi), and sub-$2,500/hr operating costs.
inductive_transitions_matrix.patron_need: Owner-operators or corporate flight departments wanting trans-continental capability on a midsize budget.
inductive_transitions_matrix.trade_off_passed: Cabin length is compact compared to super-midsize jets.

inductive_transitions_matrix.inductive_reasoning: Addresses Jet #30's runway distance: achieves a phenomenal 3,580 ft takeoff roll, landing on almost any airport in the United States with a flat-floor 6-foot stand-up cabin.
inductive_transitions_matrix.patron_need: The #1 midsize charter jet in America; fractional and corporate transport powerhouse.
inductive_transitions_matrix.trade_off_passed: 2,700 nmi range means it is strictly a continental/inter-state tool; cannot do non-stop trans-Atlantic.

inductive_transitions_matrix.inductive_reasoning: Adds 900 nmi over the Latitude: climbs directly to FL430 in under 20 minutes, flying 3,600 nmi non-stop with London City steep-approach certification.
inductive_transitions_matrix.patron_need: Fast-climbing transcontinental business jet with Gulfstream styling and support.
inductive_transitions_matrix.trade_off_passed: Slight step-down into the lavatory.

inductive_transitions_matrix.inductive_reasoning: The ultimate mountain runway weapon: can take off from a 3,530 ft strip at Aspen on a hot summer day with full fuel and fly non-stop to Miami.
inductive_transitions_matrix.patron_need: Western ranch, ski resort, and mountain town access without compromising transcontinental range.
inductive_transitions_matrix.trade_off_passed: Cabin altitude of 7,200 ft at max ceiling is higher than clean-sheet modern jets.

inductive_transitions_matrix.inductive_reasoning: Pivots from heavy super-midsize to high-speed sub-$10M executive pocket rocket: 51,000 ft ceiling (climbing over airline traffic) with forward pocket executive privacy door.
inductive_transitions_matrix.patron_need: Rapid point-to-point regional business sprints with genuine Learjet high-altitude DNA.
inductive_transitions_matrix.trade_off_passed: Bombardier ended Learjet production in 2022; new airframes are no longer manufactured.

inductive_transitions_matrix.inductive_reasoning: Closes Tier II by offering a full carbon-composite fuselage in the secondary market at under $8M, providing super-midsize space with non-corroding composite durability.
inductive_transitions_matrix.patron_need: Value-oriented corporate flight departments seeking composite luxury on a budget.
inductive_transitions_matrix.trade_off_passed: Transitions the fleet into dedicated short-runway light jets and high-efficiency turboprops.

inductive_transitions_matrix.inductive_reasoning: The undisputed global champion of light business aviation: single-pilot certified, Mach 0.80 speed, 2,010 nmi range, runway-overrun awareness and alerting system (ROAAS), and best-in-class residual value.
inductive_transitions_matrix.patron_need: The single most reliable, cost-effective inter-state business aircraft on Earth.
inductive_transitions_matrix.trade_off_passed: Paved runway required; cannot land on unpaved gravel, grass, or dirt strips.

inductive_transitions_matrix.inductive_reasoning: Directly solves Jet #36's tarmac-only limitation: engineered from scratch to land on grass, gravel, sand, and dirt strips in under 3,000 ft, featuring a pallet-sized standard cargo door.
inductive_transitions_matrix.patron_need: Loading dirt bikes, hunting gear, or medical stretchers directly into a jet that lands at remote ranches and safari reserves.
inductive_transitions_matrix.trade_off_passed: Cruise speed of Mach 0.77 is slightly slower than the Phenom 300E's Mach 0.80.

inductive_transitions_matrix.inductive_reasoning: Revolutionizes light jet packaging: engines mounted atop the wings (OTWEM) eliminate fuselage engine carry-through structures, yielding a whisper-quiet cabin and fully private aft lavatory in an entry jet.
inductive_transitions_matrix.patron_need: Single-pilot owner-operators demanding automotive Japanese engineering precision and ultra-low fuel burn.
inductive_transitions_matrix.trade_off_passed: Cabin volume and passenger capacity (5 VIPs) are smaller than the PC-24 or Phenom 300.

inductive_transitions_matrix.transition_pair: #38 HondaJet Elite II -> #39 Cessna Citation CJ4 Ge
inductive_transitions_matrix.inductive_reasoning: Addresses Jet #38's passenger limit: carries up to 9 passengers over 2,165 nmi with single-pilot certification, Williams FJ44 engines, and folding side-facing couch.
inductive_transitions_matrix.patron_need: Corporate flight departments wanting maximum passenger count on single-pilot operating costs.
inductive_transitions_matrix.trade_off_passed: Straight-wing design limits Mach speed to 0.77.

inductive_transitions_matrix.transition_pair: #39 Cessna Citation CJ4 Ge -> #40 Pilatus PC-12 NGX
inductive_transitions_matrix.inductive_reasoning: Directly slashes operating costs below $1,000/hr ($950/hr DOC): BMW Designworks executive interior, standard cargo door, sub-2,500 ft unimproved dirt strip capability, and legendary PT6 engine safety.
inductive_transitions_matrix.patron_need: The ultimate versatile family and ranch connector; landing on grass strips at Lake Tahoe or Idaho ranches.
inductive_transitions_matrix.trade_off_passed: Cruise speed of 290 knots (approx 330 mph) is slower than pure jet transport.

inductive_transitions_matrix.transition_pair: #40 Pilatus PC-12 NGX -> #41 Beechcraft King Air 36
inductive_transitions_matrix.inductive_reasoning: Answers single-engine anxiety with twin-turboprop redundancy: digital autothrottles, automatic cabin pressurization, and 9-passenger double-club cabin with multi-stop intra-state island/ranch capability.
inductive_transitions_matrix.patron_need: Government, medevac, and multi-family operations requiring twin-engine reliability over water and mountains.
inductive_transitions_matrix.trade_off_passed: Two PT6 engines consume more fuel and have higher maintenance overhead than single-engine PC-12.

inductive_transitions_matrix.transition_pair: #41 Beechcraft King Air 36 -> #42 Cessna Citation M2 Gen
inductive_transitions_matrix.inductive_reasoning: Steps up from turboprop speeds to true 404-knot jet velocity at under $6M: Garmin G3000 avionics, single-pilot operation, and access to 3,210 ft runways.
inductive_transitions_matrix.patron_need: Owner-pilots graduating from high-performance piston aircraft into their first turbine jet.
inductive_transitions_matrix.trade_off_passed: Compact cabin with emergency-style curtain lavatory.

inductive_transitions_matrix.transition_pair: #42 Cessna Citation M2 Gen -> #43 Daher TBM 960
inductive_transitions_matrix.inductive_reasoning: Combines 330-knot jet-like speed with turboprop fuel efficiency (37 gallons/hr): Garmin Emergency Autoland (the HomeSafe button lands the plane autonomously if pilot incapacitates) at $680/hr DOC.
inductive_transitions_matrix.patron_need: The ultimate owner-flown regional bullet; getting from Seattle to Palm Springs faster and cheaper than an airline.
inductive_transitions_matrix.trade_off_passed: Airstair door requires stepping past co-pilot or front seats in compact cabin.

inductive_transitions_matrix.transition_pair: #43 Daher TBM 960 -> #44 Cirrus Vision Jet G2+
inductive_transitions_matrix.inductive_reasoning: The most accessible jet on Earth: Williams single turbofan mounted on the roof, Cirrus Airframe Parachute System (CAPS) whole-plane parachute, Safe Return Autoland, and large panoramic windows at $3.25M.
inductive_transitions_matrix.patron_need: Family travel with supreme peace of mind; if anything goes wrong, a single button pulls a parachute or auto-lands the plane.
inductive_transitions_matrix.trade_off_passed: Range is 1,275 nmi; payload with full fuel limits adult passenger count.

inductive_transitions_matrix.transition_pair: #44 Cirrus Vision Jet G2+ -> #45 Embraer Phenom 100EV
inductive_transitions_matrix.inductive_reasoning: Provides true twin-engine jet redundancy with the 'Oval Lite' cabin cross-section designed by BMW Designworks, offering superior shoulder and headroom in the entry jet class.
inductive_transitions_matrix.patron_need: Corporate shuttle for short 1-to-2 hour inter-city hops (Dallas to Houston, Miami to Atlanta).
inductive_transitions_matrix.trade_off_passed: Range of 1,178 nmi requires fuel stops on transcontinental missions.

inductive_transitions_matrix.inductive_reasoning: Drops takeoff roll under 2,000 ft (1,994 ft) with a 700 SHP Pratt & Whitney engine climbing at 2,048 fpm, equipped with Garmin HALO safety system and Emergency Autoland.
inductive_transitions_matrix.patron_need: Ultra-short airstrip takeoff performance with 301-knot cruise speed and Garmin Autoland safety.
inductive_transitions_matrix.trade_off_passed: Single entry door over the wing requires active agility during cabin boarding.

inductive_transitions_matrix.transition_pair: #46 Piper M700 Fury -> #47 Beechcraft King Air 26
inductive_transitions_matrix.inductive_reasoning: Addresses over-the-wing boarding with a proper ground-level rear airstair door, twin PT6A-52 engines, and 2,111 ft takeoff roll for island hopping in the Bahamas or Caribbean.
inductive_transitions_matrix.patron_need: Rugged multi-island and inter-state hops with luggage, golf clubs, and family pets.
inductive_transitions_matrix.trade_off_passed: Slower than light jets on flights over 600 miles.

inductive_transitions_matrix.transition_pair: #47 Beechcraft King Air 26 -> #48 Cessna Citation CJ3+
inductive_transitions_matrix.inductive_reasoning: Restores 416-knot jet speed: 2,040 nmi non-stop range, Garmin G3000 flight deck, 3,180 ft takeoff roll, and low direct operating costs for 7 passengers.
inductive_transitions_matrix.patron_need: No-nonsense, highly reliable private jet travel between regional business hubs.
inductive_transitions_matrix.trade_off_passed: Straight wing profile does not achieve Mach 0.80.

inductive_transitions_matrix.inductive_reasoning: Pivots completely to extreme Short Takeoff and Landing (STOL): takes off in an astonishing 1,015 feet from mountain ledges, floats on water, or remote bush runways with 900 SHP PT6.
inductive_transitions_matrix.patron_need: Adventure expeditions, remote Alaskan fishing lodges, and backcountry island access where no other plane can land.
inductive_transitions_matrix.trade_off_passed: Unpressurized cabin requires oxygen masks above 12,000 ft; 210-knot cruise speed.

inductive_transitions_matrix.transition_pair: #49 Daher Kodiak 900 -> #50 De Havilland Canada DH
inductive_transitions_matrix.inductive_reasoning: Closes the 50-aircraft fleet by providing twin-engine redundancy on extreme STOL missions: lands on remote beaches, glaciers, and Caribbean lagoons with wheels, skis, or amphibious floats.
inductive_transitions_matrix.patron_need: The ultimate private island, superyacht tender, and alpine resort sovereign connector.
inductive_transitions_matrix.trade_off_passed: Closes the loop from the $410M Boeing 747-8 BBJ to the beach-landing Twin Otter, proving complete multi-tiered aviation supremacy.
